_comment: Contracts offered at the ship's terminal (Game/Campaign/Contracts.h). set: the first ones, in order, one at a time, the same in every campaign -- each an area of the home system by its designation, and what it pays. Then others are offered every offer_every seconds (between the two), up to max_offered waiting at once: rewards by the mission's template, more the further from home by reward_per_light_year a light year. wanted: what a contract asks, by template. leads: the note of a lead turned up by a mission done (lead_chance of the time), by template; extra_reward: what a mission's optional goal pays (its records drive brought back aboard); {place} is the area, {body} the world it is on.

wanted.download_data: Recover the data held at the facility and bring the drive back.
wanted.restore: Restore the station's power and restart its life support.
wanted.survey: Take readings at the markers set out across the area.
wanted.signal: Find the transmitter and shut it down.
wanted.activate: Get the facility's plant running again at its control console.
wanted.revive: Find the transmitter that has gone silent and bring it back on the air.

leads.restore: The station's records list traffic to {place}, {body}.
leads.survey: The readings match a source near {place}, {body}.
leads.activate: The plant's records list a link to {place}, {body}.
